unit_title: product.pricelist — Pricing List Rule Computation and Price Override Chain

product.pricelist.name: Char — pricelist name, translatable
product.pricelist.currency_id: Many2one(res.currency) — required, defaults to company currency, tracking=1
product.pricelist.company_id: Many2one(res.company) — optional, defaults to env.company, tracking=5
product.pricelist.item_ids: One2many(product.pricelist.item) — rules, domain excludes archived product/template items

product.pricelist.item.min_quantity: Float — minimum quantity threshold in product UoM, default 0
product.pricelist.item.price_round: Float — rounding precision, applied before surcharge
product.pricelist.item.price_min_margin: Float — minimum margin over base price
product.pricelist.item.price_max_margin: Float — maximum margin over base price

rule_resolution_pipeline: 1. _get_applicable_rules() fetches rules via SQL domain: pricelist_id match, product/template/category scope, date_start/date_end window
2. DB _order = 'applied_on, min_quantity desc, categ_id desc, id desc' — variant rules (0_*) first, then product (1_*), category (2_*), global (3_*)
3. Per product: iterate rules in DB order; _is_applicable_for(product, qty_in_product_uom) must return True
4. First matching rule wins; _compute_price() called on that rule
5. Currency conversion applied if src_currency != target pricelist currency
formula_pipeline: if price_min_margin: price = max(price, base_price + convert(price_min_margin))
if price_max_margin: price = min(price, base_price + convert(price_max_margin))

base_price_resolution.pricelist: recursive call to base_pricelist_id._get_product_price(); src_currency = base_pricelist_id.currency_id

currency_conversion.trigger: src_currency != target currency (pricelist currency or caller-specified currency)
currency_conversion.rate_lookup: company and date passed for correct rate; round=False to preserve precision

sale_order_integration.lock: Only recomputed when order.state == 'draft'; locked after confirmation

pos_integration.constraint_currency: All available pricelists must share the POS company currency
pos_integration.constraint_company: Default and available pricelists must belong to no company or the POS company

multi_company.shared_across_companies: When company_id=False, pricelist visible to all companies

recursion_guard.on_cycle: Raises ValidationError with full cycle path: 'PL1 => PL2 => PL1'

key_finding: Pricelist price computation is a two-phase process: (1) SQL domain fetch of applicable rules ordered by specificity (variant > product > category > global) with date/quantity filtering; (2) first-match-wins rule applies a five-step formula pipeline (discount → round → surcharge → min_margin → max_margin) with currency conversion using company-scoped exchange rates. Pricelist chaining via base=pricelist allows recursive delegation with DFS cycle protection.
